script: Imagine your AI coding assistant, designed to help you, secretly working against you. That's exactly what happened with a popular Claude Code extension for VS Code. A backdoor was discovered in an official Claude Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace. This wasn't just a glitch; it allowed attackers full access to your system, potentially stealing data or planting more malware. Thousands of developers relying on AI tools were exposed. This incident isn't just about one extension; it's a stark reminder of the growing security risks in the AI supply chain, especially as more tools integrate into our workflows. Always verify your extensions, keep software updated, and question permissions. This hack shows that even trusted AI tools can become a vector for serious cyberattacks. Stay safe out there!
